name: Aloura
summary: Aloura is wrapped in fabric from edge to edge, creating a seamless and sculptural form. The smooth surface and refined texture give it quiet distinction, while the clean lines enhance its modern elegance. With understated presence and timeless appeal, it is designed to bring warmth and refinement to any interior. 67x67x87
